title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: coap_msg.c has 2 mutating handlers not refactored for OSCORE
description: Two mutating handlers in coap_msg.c (lines 419 and 759) still use bare lichen_coap_is_local_admin() without refactoring to coap_oscore_authorize_mutating(). This prevents OSCORE-authenticated mesh peers from sending messages or acknowledging them.
